shared_elements: human figure / anthropomorphic face in frontal view
bilaterally symmetrical composition about a vertical axis
low-relief schematic carving of ornament on a flat field
justification: Both surfaces show schematic low-relief human/anthropomorphic imagery organised symmetrically about a vertical axis, with circular disc motifs and curved bands, but these are near-universal features. A is a densely populated framed narrative panel with a central tree flanked by seated, costumed figures and scroll-filled borders, whereas B is a single massive frontal figure whose body carries a few isolated, widely spaced discs and arcs with no scene, no attendants and no framing register.
